text: Artificial Intelligence is developing quickly, and experts often discuss two types. General AI, also called AGI, would be a machine that can think and learn like a human. This kind of AI could solve big problems in medicine and science, and it might help us fight climate change. However, there are also risks. AGI could take away many jobs or even become difficult to control. Scientists disagree about when AGI will arrive. Some think it is only ten years away, while others believe it may take fifty years or more.
